exposure: Children exposed to anti-TNF-alpha and/or thiopurine
In utero exposure to anti-tumor necrosis factor-alpha (anti-TNF-alpha)
Children not exposed to anti-TNF-alpha and/or thiopurine
cohort: 1000 children born to 626 mothers with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in the Netherlands between 1999 and 2018.
finding: There was no association between in utero exposure to anti-TNF-alpha and/or thiopurine and adverse long-term health outcomes in children born to mothers with IBD.
